probe.measured: Where large-v3's run-to-run instability comes from, counted rather than inferred: how many decode passes each sub-30s utterance takes, how many previous-text tokens each pass is handed, and how many decode attempts the temperature fallback rejects -- with conditioning on and off.

finding.reading: 3 of 200 utterances take more than one decode pass despite none exceeding one 30s window (longest 20.3s). With conditioning ON, 3 of them had a later pass handed previous text; with it OFF, none did -- so the flag acts on ordinary dictation-length audio and the finding is not confined to long files. The temperature fallback -- the only sampled step, and so the only thing that can make a decode differ between runs -- rejected no decode attempt at all on this model, across 200 utterances. A model that never reaches it is reproducible whatever the fallback is configured to do.
